decision.observed_event: Twenty-one, 20 gp a side. Your cards: 6 of diamonds and queen of spades, 16. The dealer shows the queen of hearts. You take the 8 of hearts: 24. Bust. You lose 20 gp to the house.

improv_read.connection: The house wins and Uktarl wants more.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit lays out the bust plainly and lets the table needle her.

public_brief.objective: Keep the loser at the table for another round.
public_brief.tactic: Rake the gold gracefully and invite her straight back in.
public_brief.visible_cue: He rakes her twenty gold across the table; the fresco-side player chuckles.
public_brief.player_opening: She can play again, change how she plays, or walk away.
public_brief.reply_to: Fine, twenty, and I'll play it out. Hit.
public_brief.kit_focus: Play the cards out cleanly and quickly, then give the table its little reaction.
public_brief.mirror: steady energy, standard, dry humor: let the table needle her loss lightly

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Twenty gold each goes into the middle. The dealer flicks her the six of diamonds and the queen of spades, and turns up his own queen of hearts. Wren taps for another: the eight of hearts lands on top. Twenty-four. Bust. The dealer rakes her twenty gold across the wood without a word, and the fresco-side player chuckles into his collar.

segments.speaker: Fresco-side player
segments.text: The queen always comes for you.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Unkind of her, and so early in the evening. Twenty-one is a fickle mistress, my bold guest, but she rewards those who come back to her. Another round?
